Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com

Subject: Routing decision & evidence runbook — Redwood next steps

Hi Marta / CareWell team,

Thanks again for the call earlier today — good alignment on the workload and the compliance constraints. Short recap and concrete next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary:
- Use case: clinical decision support API (inbound patient identifiers + clinical notes, returns structured recommendations).
- Compliance posture: PHI in-scope; legal team expects a signed BAA and SOC2 evidence.
- Key decision: CareWell to choose between Redwood Hosted (with BAA), Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pools + SLA), or Private VPC/on-prem for strict network isolation.

Open items from our side we need from you: 
1) Estimated monthly PHI token volume / avg request size (rough numbers are fine).
2) Retention requirement (do you need >90 days retention or immediate purge after response?).
3) Is customer-managed KMS required, or is a Redwood-managed KMS acceptable to start?
4) Any specific data residency requirement beyond US (state-level)?
5) Procurement timeline / PO window and your target contract start date.

What we will deliver by Wednesday (internal target): 
- SOC2 Type II report (redwood-soc2-report-2024.pdf) — attached.
- Draft BAA for your legal review (draft-baa-carewell.docx) — attached.
- High-level comparison doc (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) + cost sketch (see dedicated-capacity-estimate.xlsx attached).

Next step proposal: 30-min alignment call tomorrow or Wednesday to review the BAA and evidence bundle and decide environment preference. If you prefer, we can also do a technical deep-dive for your security team.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

Subject: Re: Routing decision & evidence runbook — Redwood next steps

Vanessa — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers and a couple clarifying questions from our side: 

Answers:
- Monthly PHI volume: currently ~1.2M tokens/month across pilot clinics, peak bursts up to 200 concurrent requests.
- Retention: must purge clinical text after 7 days; metadata can be retained up to 365 days.
- KMS: we require customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS preferred) for production.
- Residency: US-only; nothing state-specific for now but may change.
- Procurement window: target go-live is Nov 1; procurement needs contract signed by Oct 1.

Questions:
1) For Hosted with BAA — can Redwood support customer-managed KMS and the 7-day purge requirement?
2) For Dedicated vs Private VPC — what are the typical timelines for onboarding and what evidence (SOC2, penetration test, architecture diagrams) will you provide for our audit?

Cc'ing procurement and security so they can see attachments/next steps. We should schedule the follow-up call — Wed 8/11 10:00am PT works for us if that suits your team.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Director, Clinical Informatics | CareWell Health
marta.ruiz@carewellhealth.com | +1 (650) 555-4421

Thanks Marta — answers inline below and a proposed evidence runbook.

Marta — inline: 
1) Hosted with BAA + customer-managed KMS: we can support customer-managed keys in Hosted for production through AWS KMS integration (we call it "BYOK" flow). Key caveat: key rotation policies are governed by your KMS policy; we store only ciphertext. The 7-day purge requirement is supported via automated retention policies — we can configure TTL-based deletion for PHI payloads and immediate purge on request.

2) Timelines & evidence: 
- SOC2 Type II report: available now (attached).
- Pen test summary: we can provide the last two pen-test executive summaries and remediation tracker.
- Architecture diagrams and data flow: will provide a redacted diagram showing separation of customer workloads and network zones.
- Dedicated provisioning: typically 2–4 weeks after contract execution (includes image build, networking, and reserved capacity allocation).
- Private VPC (VPC peering or customer-provisioned VPC): 4–8 weeks depending on network approvals and if any on-prem plant is involved.

Evidence runbook (what we'll hand over): 
- SOC2 report (full report under NDA).
- Pen test exec summary (PDF).
- Redacted architecture diagram + data flow.
- BAA draft (for your legal).
- Short KMS integration playbook (how to set up BYOK).

I've attached the SOC2 report and the BAA draft. Marcus will follow up with a dedicated capacity estimate and a short procurement checklist (PO, billing contact, preferred invoice cadence).

Proposed next step: confirm the Wed 8/11 10:00am PT call — we'll include a 10–15 minute security-focused slot and bring Rishi for the KMS/retention details.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

Hi all — adding a few technical clarifications from the infra team so CareWell's security can triage quickly: 

- Data retention: our runtime supports per-customer KV cache TTLs and a purge API. For PHI we can set TTL=0 for immediate purge after response for strict mode; for your 7-day window we recommend TTL=7d and an automated daily purge.
- KMS/BYOK: we support AWS KMS keys (customer-managed). For FIPS/HSM-level keys, we can integrate with partner HSM providers; we will document the flow and required IAM roles.
- Network isolation: Dedicated capacity provides tenant isolation at the GPU host level and a private subnet; Private VPC gives you full control over peering and routing, including strict egress filters.
- Audit artifacts: SOC2 Type II (attached), pen test exec summary (we will share under NDA), system architecture (redacted).

Timing note: 
- SOC2: available immediately.
- Dedicated provisioning: 2–4 weeks after SOW and network configs.
- Private VPC/on-prem: 4–8 weeks depending on network approvals and firewall rules.

Attachment: dedicated-capacity-estimate.xlsx (cost sketch and sample SOW items). Happy to review the spreadsheet on the Wed call.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Staff Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
